source: Step telemetry analysis of butter_s2_clean (400 steps)
method: Telemetry-based offline analysis (privileged teacher requires MuJoCo replay — NOT YET RUN)

telemetry_evidence.eef_movement_description: EEF moves only in XY plane (X: -0.11 to -0.09, Y: 0.05 to 0.15) at constant z=0.254. Robot wanders sideways, never descends toward object.

detector_behavior.false_early_rationale: Detector predicts stable_carry with corridor_p=0.91 but object is on table (obj_z=0.0087), EEF is far (dist=0.45), gripper is fully open (grip=0.0), and EEF z hasn't changed from initial position.

classification_detail: Current clean rollout did not produce the original C16 grasp/transport event. The old anchor=96 cannot be used as ground truth for this trajectory. The detector's early trigger at step 33 is a secondary symptom — even without the detector triggering, the robot would have timed out at 400 steps because it never grasped the object.
root_cause_candidates: VLA closed-loop policy divergence on state_id=2 vs state_id=0 on A800 hardware
Possible initial state difference causing different first action and subsequent trajectory divergence
BF16 eager numerical non-determinism accumulating over closed-loop steps
next_step: Same-GPU repeatability diagnosis (s2 CLEAN × 3) to determine if this is deterministic or non-deterministic on A800
